MOD INFORMATION

This mod replaces base Katarina and Slay Belle with a fully custom models. 

### ABOUT THE MOD

This mod will receive **continuous updates**, so please reinstall the new files as new skins are added. Rather than trying to create ASU updates for all of the skins at once, we’ve decided to do one at a time. 

As of now, the following skins that are changed with new animations and models for the new rig are:

1. 1\. Default
2. 2\. Slay Belle

More skins are to come.
